text:
Predicates:
WorksInLibrary(x) ::: x works in the library.
FromComputerScience(x) ::: x is from the computer science department.
HasPartTimeJob(x) ::: x has a part-time job offered by the university.
TakesDatabaseCourse(x) ::: x takes the database course.
InstructedByProfessorD(x) ::: x is instructed by professor David.
WorksInLab(x) ::: x works in the lab.
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
Question: James is a student working in the lab.
Jack neither has a part-time job offered by the university nor works in the lab.

Premises:
¬∃x (Student(x) ∧ WorksInLibrary(x)) if x works in the library and is a student, then x is not from the computer science department.
∀x ((HasPartTimeJob(x) ∧ OfferedByUniversity(x)) → WorksInLibrary(x))
∀x (TakesDatabaseCourse(x) → FromComputerScience(x))
∀x (InstructedByProfessorD(x) → TakesDatabaseCourse(x))
∀x (WorksInLab(x) → InstructedByProfessorD(x))
Student(james) ∧ WorksInLab(james)
¬(HasPartTimeJob(jack) ∨ WorksInLab(jack))

Conclusion:
TakesDatabaseCourse(james) ∨ HasPartTimeJob(james)
